scope: Every component Rust package, including fixtures and fuzz tooling. clausters-editor is inventoried under the separate editor audit unit.
acceptance: Every inventoried package must have source-specific test/review evidence. Unknown/new crates remain in scope automatically. Host test pass does not establish wasm or FFI safety.

steps.instructions: Follow procedures/crates.md. Supply crate_coverage keyed by every manifest in the recorded inventory, with per-crate status, reason and retained evidence reference. Review all features/target seams, including wasm/FFI/plugin paths, fuzz and test fixture crates. Only clausters-editor is excluded.
